media.caption: Modern, nonmeasured relationship guide from HES’s textual description. House 1 has a central hearth, shelving beyond, two slab enclosures per side and an additional wider enclosure left of the entrance: five enclosures in total. Nineteenth-century rebuilding omitted recorded cells; the present interior differs from the excavation record. No source plan or photograph was copied.
